case_title: RUI FU LIAO VS. JUSTIN CHAN FON TSAI

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JUL-07-2021 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JUL-07-2021 BY MICHELLE TONG.
